name: model3d-viewer
description: Default interactive 3D viewer for STL and Bambu Studio multi-color 3MF/OBJ/GLB/PLY models in the side panel and inline chat, with calibrated studio self-shadows, multi-color/grey toggle, black or natural oak desk backdrop (with optional mat), upright object spin + clamped camera orbit, Bambu Lab filament matching, and one-click Bambu multi-color 3MF / binary STL export.
suggestedPrompts: Open my latest Bambu 3MF and STL models in the 3D Print Viewer side panel
Compare up to 5 STL iterations side-by-side and match colors to Bambu Lab PLA filaments
Show a compact inline 3D preview of this model on a simulated desk
